messages:
quentin: quick bring-up notes for zephyr-10b-slim (int8 baseline vs int5-hybrid). Did a focused GTN slice pass and econ sim. Short summary below.

maya: paste core numbers please. need a single-paragraph recommendation for product.

quentin: mixed-traffic micro-sample (median prompt 50 tok):
- int8 baseline: p50 92ms, p95 240ms, throughput 235 tok/s, unit cost $0.011/token-eq
- int5-hybrid: p50 108ms, p95 295ms, throughput 285 tok/s, unit cost $0.0068/token-eq (~38% cheaper)
quality (aggregated GTN slices, n=5.6k):
- short QA EM: int8 79.2%, int5-hybrid 78.1% (delta -1.1 pts, CI +/-0.6)
- rerank proxy NDCG: int8 0.71, int5-hybrid 0.707 (-0.4%)
- long summarization ROUGE-proxy: int8 0.60, int5-hybrid 0.55 (-8.3%), long slice n=900 -> high variance
- hallucination proxy: int8 3.5%, int5-hybrid 4.1%
notes: int5-hybrid wins amplify with prefix cache hit rates; longform and multi-shot few-shot prompts show larger deltas.

leah: p95 for int5 looks high. ops?

ops-bot: created ticket #KERN-2140 to investigate int5-hybrid fallback and batch-shape tuning (owner: @sam). ETA 72h.

sam: kernel note  fallback happens for certain token widths; enabling fused-pack and adjust batch cap reduces p95 by ~40-70ms in microbench.

maya: proposed routing (conservative) for GTN:
- shortform: intent in [search_snippet, rerank, qa_short] -> split int5-hybrid 0.6, int8 0.4
- convo: assistant_chat -> split int5-hybrid 0.45, int8 0.55
- longform: summarize_long, doc_analysis -> int8 1.0
canary: 1% for 1h -> 5% for 4h -> 25% w/ automated QA_EM & latency checks
rollbacks: if QA_EM drop >1.5 pts abs on a slice over 30m -> rollback; if hallucination +0.8% abs -> rollback. require min-sample n>=400 before auto-rollback.

quentin: GTN bullets (one-paragraph): "Recommend introducing zephyr-10b-slim int5-hybrid for high-volume short-form workloads. Typical token-unit cost decreases ~38% vs int8 with minor short-form quality deltas (~1pt EM); avoid longform/few-shot until kernel tuning and a 48h A/B tighten CI. Canary + per-slice rollback and opt-out for enterprise longform included."

leah: savings example for a mid-market GTN (25M tok/mo): eligible 65% -> 16.25M * (0.011 - 0.0068) = ~$70.1k/mo gross; realistic realized ~60% -> ~$42k/mo. include note about billed token-eq.

sam: action items: 1) infra ticket #KERN-2140 (owner: sam) to tune fused-pack and batch-shape; 2) leah run 48h A/B on longform (target 20k samples); 3) quentin to post GTN note + per-slice CSVs; 4) maya to draft customer comms and opt-out for longform.

ops-bot: canary deploy started for route "zephyr-short-probe" -> 1% at 1792223533 :rotating_light:

quentin: will post full note in 45m. thanks all :thumbsup:
